title: DECISION: Use DB metadata for peer-fetched attachments, not URL params
description: blob_download_handler (lib.rs:270-271) uses DB metadata (info.content_type, info.filename) for peer-fetched blobs, not URL params used in local-hit path. Defensive: avoids trusting attacker-controlled URL parameters for peer-delivered content. Metadata is from verified peer delivery via Peer/deliver.
